defect_fixed: SessionReadinessValidator state was in-memory only; a process restart after 10:00 ET caused every symbol to read DATA_NOT_READY regardless of the true opening-minute data quality (confirmed live 2026-08-24, Task 65B run 2: 0/35 READY on restart, restoring 35/35 warmup-ready but zero decision-eligible symbols).

new_public_api: load_readiness_state(path) -> dict | None -- raises ReadinessStateError on malformed JSON, never conflates missing with corrupt
implementation.persisted_file: session_readiness_state.json under the PIV runtime state directory
implementation.wiring: talonx_piv/session_runner.py: restore_state() called once per session-date rollover (covers both a genuine new trading day and a mid-day process restart, since both look identical to a fresh SessionRunner instance); to_state() persisted after every tick that observed new bars and after every finalize_readiness() call.

scenarios_covered: restart after 10:00 ET retains previously established eligibility (the exact live incident)
malformed state fails closed (5 parametrized shapes)
missing state file reports MISSING (not INVALID)
a corrupt individual symbol entry cannot become eligible while other symbols in the same state restore correctly
no synthetic data is created across a persist/restore round trip
persistence survives a normal save->new-process->load->restore cycle
session reset next trading day works correctly (stale rejection + fresh observation)
a PENDING (not-yet-finalized) symbol restores its raw observations so live accumulation continues correctly

integration_test.description: End-to-end: a fresh SessionRunner instance sharing the same state_dir as a finalized-READY prior run restores that decision and emits SESSION_READINESS_STATE_RESTORED, without re-deriving DATA_NOT_READY from a cold validator.

opening_completeness_requirement_unchang: 30-minute (09:30-09:59 ET) full-opening-data requirement is untouched; persistence only preserves the outcome of that unchanged evaluation across a restart, never relaxes it.
